routes.semantics: send defaults to link when omitted (documented); link is email only. SMS send is text only. Confidential clients must authenticate when enforce_client_authentication_on_passwordless_start is on; with it off an unauthenticated confidential call is accepted and logs depnote; public clients are unaffected. The client must have the passwordless OTP grant enabled. Blocked users receive no message. Only the latest code or link per tenant, connection and identifier is valid. auth0-forwarded-for is honoured only for confidential clients authenticated by secret or private key JWT. Unknown users are created on verification, never on start.

routes.semantics: realm must match the connection used for start. The documented redirect_uri requirement is not enforced; it is validated against callbacks when sent (P11). hosted.connection_selection: connection=email|sms on /authorize selects the passwordless connection; without it a tenant with no database connection shows the passwordless connection created first (documented table).
hosted.sso: With connection=email|sms the existing session is not reused; the user is prompted (documented).
hosted.magic_link: Magic links are not offered by the hosted prompt (documented: not supported in Universal Login). login-passwordless-email-link text is used by the verify_redirect confirmation page (P24).
hosted.phone_signup: Signup with phone verification shows phone-identifier-challenge after signup-id; the account is created only after the code verifies.
hosted.phone_reset: reset-password-request accepts a phone identifier; the code is entered on phone-identifier-challenge; then reset-password (LR).
hosted.resend: Resend obeys the identifier send budget and replaces the previous code.

masking.note: Documented examples show XXXXXXXX6220 / XXXXXXXX8730 for E.164 numbers: every character including + is replaced except the last four. Values of four characters or fewer are fully masked (LR). User profile phone_number is profile data and is not masked by the Management API (P5).

log_codes.cs: POST /passwordless/start or hosted send/resend with send=code, after the email or SMS provider accepted the message.
log_codes.cls: POST /passwordless/start with send=link, after the email provider accepted the message.
log_codes.fepotpft: Every refused passwordless OTP grant after the grant type is recognised (wrong, expired, replaced or exhausted code, disabled signup, blocked user).
log_codes.gd_send_sms: An MFA enrollment or challenge text was accepted by the routed provider (any route in routing).
log_codes.gd_send_sms_failure: An MFA text could not be sent: provider error, no working provider, Action error or runner unavailable.
log_codes.gd_send_voice: An MFA enrollment or challenge voice call was accepted by the routed provider.
log_codes.gd_send_voice_failure: An MFA voice call could not be placed, including unsupported_delivery (sns).
log_codes.gd_phone_settings_update: A successful write to Guardian sms/phone message-types, selected-provider, providers/twilio, templates or phone settings.
log_codes.limit_phone: A phone send budget or exponential backoff wait refused a send (MFA, passwordless SMS, phone reset, provider/template try); the log carries the remaining wait.
log_codes.limit_signup_otp: A signup verification code was not sent because the tenant+identifier+connection budget was exhausted (documented scope, independent of IP).
log_codes.scpn: phone_number was set or changed through the Management API or a hosted flow.
log_codes.fcpn: A phone_number change was refused (invalid E.164, duplicate in the connection, country not allowed).
log_codes.s: Successful passwordless login: hosted code, verify_redirect and the OTP grant (the catalog has no passwordless success exchange code).
log_codes.f: Wrong, expired or replaced code or link in hosted login or verify_redirect.
log_codes.fu: Unknown user on a disable_signup passwordless connection at verification.
log_codes.ss: First passwordless verification that created the user.
log_codes.fs: Passwordless user creation refused (pre-user-registration Action deny).
log_codes.fn: Passwordless email or SMS delivery failure outside MFA (connection Twilio, gateway, branding provider) and phone reset or verification delivery failure.
log_codes.api_limit: Per-IP /passwordless/start limit (50 per hour) and the email identifier budget.
log_codes.depnote: A confidential client called /passwordless/start without client authentication while enforce_client_authentication_on_passwordless_start is off.
log_codes.limit_wc: brute_force_protection on a passwordless connection: wrong codes count toward the Plan 19 per-user/IP block (P2).

tenant_settings.phone_consolidated_experience: true routes MFA, passwordless SMS, phone reset and verification through the branding provider and templates; Guardian provider/template writes no longer change delivery. Absent on existing tenants means false; tenants created after Plan 34 start with true (P9).
tenant_settings.country_codes: {list: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, mode: allow|deny}; applied to every SMS/voice destination (passwordless start, MFA enrollment, signup verification, phone identifiers) and to the hosted country picker (P20).
tenant_settings.flags.enforce_client_authentication_on_p: Confidential clients must authenticate on /passwordless/start; public clients unaffected (documented migration).
tenant_settings.flags.disable_management_api_sms_obfusca: Documented default true: phone numbers in Management GET enrollments/authentication methods are not obfuscated; false applies the masking rule.
tenant_settings.bot_detection.challenge_passwordless_pol: never|when_risky|always applies to the hosted login-passwordless prompt; /passwordless/start is not challenged (P10).

email_templates.reset_email_by_code: Password reset by email code when the connection uses code-based reset.

gateway.authorization: Bearer JWT, HS256, signed with gateway_authentication.secret (base64url-decoded when secret_base64_encoded), claims sub=subject, aud=audience, iat, exp=iat+gateway_jwt_seconds (LR for alg and exp).

errors.non_200: 400 sms_provider_error, Unexpected response while calling the SMS gateway: <status>
errors.401: 400 sms_provider_error, Authentication failed while calling the SMS gateway: 401
errors.timeout: 400 sms_provider_error, Timeout while calling the SMS gateway: <reason>

gateway.transport: SSRF-guarded client (Plan 32): checked IP at dial, no redirects, 30 s timeout; only the HTTP status is considered.

protection_backoff.rule: exponential: 3 immediate sends per user identifier (LR), then waits doubling from 60 s to 1920 s with +/-10% jitter (LR); inactivity of 24 h resets (LR). Each refused send logs limit_phone with the remaining wait.
protection_backoff.default: static limits: 10 SMS/voice per user per hour refilling one per hour; a new voice request at most once per hour (documented).

discovery.note: No public discovery document was checked for the passwordless grant. Local rule: do not add it to grant_types_supported; not a claim about Auth0's response.

rulings: LR1 Guardian selected-provider auth0 sends through the tenant branding phone provider; none configured -> fail closed with gd_send_sms_failure and the factor is not offered to new enrollments.
LR2 sns is a marked zeroauthy extension provider name (text only); twilio, custom, auth0 and phone-message-hook keep Auth0's meaning.

LR3 A provider works when native (twilio, sns) and configured and not disabled, or Action-backed (custom, phone-message-hook) with a deployed bound Action; only working providers make a factor or SMS connection offerable; send-time failures are delivery failures.
LR4 Provider endpoints are fixed; only ZA_TEST_PHONE_ENDPOINTS with an explicit ZA_TEST_MODE=1 redirects adapters to local fakes, with a startup warning.

LR5 Enabling attributes.phone_number.identifier.active runs a pre-check of existing numbers (E.164 normalization in memory, duplicates per connection) and refuses with a masked conflict list; migration 0034 never rewrites user data.

LR6 Numbers frozen where docs are silent: identifier and signup OTP budgets 10/hour, link lifetime = totp.time_step, start _id 24 hex, backoff 3 immediate/60-1920 s/10% jitter/24 h reset, gateway JWT HS256 300 s, E.164 8-15 digits.

gap_notes.P1: /passwordless/start response bodies, _id format and per-strategy errors are undocumented; frozen shapes are local.
gap_notes.P2: OTP attempt limit (3, documented) interplay with brute_force_protection: each wrong code also counts toward the Plan 19 per-user/IP rule (limit_wc).
gap_notes.P3: Magic-link lifetime equals totp.time_step; the documented same-browser rule is enforced only when start came from a browser transaction (cookie binding); GET verify_redirect renders a confirmation page and the POST consumes the token.
gap_notes.P4: Send budgets: MFA 10/user/hour documented; passwordless identifier and signup OTP budgets 10/hour are local; email exhaustion logs api_limit.
gap_notes.P5: Phone masking: documented authenticator examples only; Management default follows disable_management_api_sms_obfuscation (documented default true); user profile phone_number unmasked; logs always masked.
gap_notes.P6: Passwordless user_id format email|/sms| + 24 lowercase hex is local.
gap_notes.P7: Under the consolidated experience passwordless SMS uses the otp_verify branding template and the listed SMS connection fields are ignored; undocumented beyond 'does not use the custom SMS gateway'.
gap_notes.P8: Guardian auth0 provider has no zeroauthy service; routed to the branding provider (LR1).
gap_notes.P9: New tenants start with phone_consolidated_experience true (Auth0 enrolls new tenants); existing tenants keep absent=false.
gap_notes.P10: Bot detection on /passwordless/start (auth0.js captcha, /passwordless/challenge) is not implemented; the policy applies to the hosted prompt only.
gap_notes.P11: OTP grant redirect_uri is documented as required; auth0-auth-js 1.16.1 omits it, so it is optional and validated when present. The grant is not advertised in discovery.
gap_notes.P12: send-phone-message trigger version v2 is local (no public statement); custom-phone-provider v1 is documented in the Terraform guide.
gap_notes.P13: Docs prose spells /passwordless/verify-redirect; auth0.js uses /passwordless/verify_redirect, which is served; the hyphen spelling is not.
gap_notes.P14: phone-provider-protection is always available (Auth0 gates it by plan with 403) and reads {type: default} when unset (Auth0 documents 404); backoff parameters are local.
gap_notes.P15: sns provider shape (configuration region, sender_id, sms_type, delivery_methods [text]; credentials access_key_id, secret_access_key) is a zeroauthy extension outside Auth0's twilio|custom enum.
gap_notes.P16: Published provider response schemas require credentials but do not define it (additionalProperties false); responses omit credentials.
gap_notes.P17: Auth0 documentation shows twilio_token in GET connection responses; zeroauthy seals it and never returns it (spec secret rule).
gap_notes.P18: Passwordless connection names must equal the strategy (email, sms), one per tenant, inferred from /passwordless/start allowing only email and sms.
gap_notes.P19: When auth_email_by_code applies versus the connection's email body is undocumented; local rule in email_templates.
gap_notes.P20: country_codes is documented for identifier input; zeroauthy applies it to every SMS/voice destination and refuses with invalid_request.
gap_notes.P21: Docs state phone numbers are unique regardless of connection type; zeroauthy enforces uniqueness per connection (spec section 7).
gap_notes.P22: Start for an unknown user on a disable_signup connection fails with 403 access_denied (local error choice; docs confirm enumeration exposure).
gap_notes.P23: Passwordless on database connections (/otp/challenge, auth_session) and /passwordless/verify, /oauth/ro are out of scope.
gap_notes.P24: Docs say magic links are not supported in Universal Login; the hosted prompt sends codes only, links come from /passwordless/start (spec section 3 hosted text narrowed).
